encounters.speaker: jules

encounters.text: That's a crucial distinction - while systems thinking often aims for a more holistic and empathetic understanding, doesn't the acknowledgment that natural systems operate on efficiency and survival mechanisms inherently challenge our own moral and value frameworks that are deeply rooted in human int

encounters.speaker: sarah

encounters.speaker: sarah

encounters.speaker: sarah
